Bug_Title: DMI: Collections should not contain themselves (DMI_COLLECTIONS_SHOULD_NOT_CONTAIN_THEMSELVES)
Bug_Details:
This call to a generic collection's method would only make sense if a collection contained
itself (e.g., if s.contains(s) were true). This is unlikely to be true and would cause
problems if it were true (such as the computation of the hash code resulting in infinite recursion).
It is likely that the wrong value is being passed as a parameter.
     s.contains(s)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by adding a collection to itself using setContainer.add(setContainer). This creates a self-referential structure that can lead to issues such as infinite recursion when computing hash codes.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method. The method adds a set to itself, creating a self-referential structure. The assertFalse assertion checks if the set contains itself, which returns true, causing the test to fail.
